title: Every Single Time
logline: When Bo can’t make himself leave home for the Learning Circle, Keen and Aida help him discover that the thing he wants to hide may be the very thing that helps him belong.

orderedEvents.text: Golden morning light. Dew sparkles on wildflowers. A honeycomb sits on a small stump. KEEN tiptoes toward it. He lifts his knees high with every step.
CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH.
Keen freezes each time. He spots the honeycomb. His eyes widen. He LICKS HIS LIPS. He reaches toward the honey. FUZZBY the bee is asleep on top of the honeycomb.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
A small snore bubble grows from his nose. Keen reaches closer to the honey. POP! The bubble bursts. Keen FREEZES.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
Another bubble slowly grows. Keen inches closer to the honey.
POP! The second bubble bursts.

beats.storyBeat: Keen’s secret honey mission begins as a wordless stealth game: the dew-bright meadow looks inviting, but every lifted-knee step makes the ground betray him. The joke is that he is trying to be daring before he is actually skillful, and Fuzzby’s sleeping body on the prize makes the obstacle tiny, specific and funny.
beats.want: Keen wants to reach the honeycomb without waking Fuzzby.
beats.need: He needs to discover that boldness without awareness is just noisy appetite.
beats.kidRead: Keen is sneaking for honey and the crunchy steps keep ruining it.
beats.adultRead: A child trying to perform competence is undone by his own body before anyone else even intervenes.
beats.emotionalIntent: Playful suspense with a smile already forming.

beats.storyBeat: Aida’s crystal-bowl stillness shifts the episode from mischief to meaning. Her rose light opens a full-frame vision of Bo stuck inside his hollow, packing and unpacking but unable to move.
beats.want: Aida wants to listen deeply enough to know who needs her attention.
beats.need: She needs to respond to stuckness with witnessing before action.
beats.kidRead: Aida’s glowing bowl shows her a squirrel who can’t leave home.
beats.adultRead: The caregiver senses a child’s hidden loop before the child has language for it, and the vision respects that stillness instead of rushing to fix it.
beats.emotionalIntent: Mystery, tenderness and quiet concern.

beats.storyBeat: Inside the warm hollow, Bo is surrounded by safety but trapped by the ordinary act of leaving. His mother’s offscreen reminder is practical and kind, while Bo bargains with the conker for more time.
beats.want: Bo wants to postpone leaving while appearing almost ready.
beats.need: He needs to let the first step be imperfect instead of rehearsing until certainty arrives.
beats.kidRead: Bo does not want to go yet and talks to his conker.
beats.adultRead: The domestic warmth does not erase the child’s threshold fear; the home voice is loving, but the step still has to be his.
beats.emotionalIntent: Cozy, funny avoidance with a tightening undertow.
